text:
Elaine: FYI prepping tech handoff for Contoso POC. Need final alignment on acceptance criteria so ENG & SRE can size. Short notes below — please react with :thumbsup: if ok or reply with blockers.
Omar: Quick clarification — Contoso needs two paths: chat endpoint for support (short prompts, ~40 tokens avg) and a long-context assistant for internal KB (avg ~700 tokens). Confirming both will impact model choice and cost.
Priya: From pricing side they proposed a POC burn cap of $2,000/month. We need token/QPS estimates to see if that is feasible for the requested traffic shape.
Matt: For the chat flow on dedicated we can aim for p50 < 120ms and p95 < 450ms for the short prompts (7B quantized). For long-context requests expect p50 ~350-600ms, p95 could be ~1.2s depending on sequence length and KV cache hit rate. Which model variant is preferred?
Jin: Ops needs a traffic profile to size autoscale. Please confirm baseline vs peak. Also need concurrency per session — are they streaming or non-streaming responses?
Elaine: I asked Karen for details. Karen: baseline ~8 RPS steady with predictable spikes up to ~60 RPS during business hours. Most sessions make ~3 calls. Streaming preferred for chat.
Karen: Also security asks: KMS with keys in us-west-2, SOC2 evidence, and 30-day audit log retention. Can Redwood confirm?
security-bot: Noted — Redwood Private and Dedicated support customer-managed keys (KMS) in supported regions; SOC2 report link: https://redwood.example/soc2; default audit retention 30 days available as an option.
Matt: To meet the chat latency SLOs at 60 RPS we recommend 2 dedicated pods with KV cache enabled and batching target ~16ms. Estimated POC infra cost: ~$1,200/month + egress/network ~$300 — leaves headroom under the $2k cap. This assumes an optimized 7-8B quantized model.
Omar: Proposed success criteria (draft):
  1) Latency: chat p95 <= 500ms (short prompts), long-context p95 <= 1.2s
  2) Quality: automated eval + human spot-check: human pass rate >= 85% on customer prompt suite
  3) Cost: POC total burn <= $2,000/month
  4) Reliability: >=99.5% success rate during test windows
Jin: Ops acceptance test: run a controlled 7-day window with traffic replay using their prompt set at 1x baseline and 3x peak for 1-hour windows. We'll capture latency, error rates, and KV cache hit ratio.
Priya: Add contract clause: POC cap $2k; overages require written approval. I'll draft language and share. Also need sign-off owners: AE (Elaine), Solutions Eng (Omar), Customer PM (Karen).
Elaine: Draft runbook snippet (paste into playbook):
```
EVAL_SUITE: contoso_support_v1
SAMPLES: 5000
METRICS:
  - latency_p95_threshold_ms: 500
  - quality_human_pass_rate: 0.85
  - cost_cap_usd: 2000
WINDOW: 7 days
TRAFFIC_PROFILE:
  - baseline_rps: 8
  - peak_rps: 60
  - burst_duration_sec: 20
CANARY_POLICY:
  - percentage: 10
  - duration_hours: 24
FALLBACK: smaller-3B-quantized
```
Please review and flag missing pieces.
Karen: This looks fine. One customer request — include an automatic fallback routing to a smaller model if p95 latency breaches threshold for more than 5 minutes. Need an ops playbook for failed-eval rollback.
Jin: We can implement routing: primary 8B optimized, fallback 3B quantized; configure alerting for sustained p95 breaches >5m and auto-switch to fallback with a canary rollout back to primary once healthy.
Matt: I'll add autoscale thresholds and cost telemetry hooks to the runbook so we can produce a final estimate.
Elaine: Action items: Omar -> final cost calc and model choice by EOD; Matt/Jin -> add autoscale + fallback config to runbook; Priya -> draft POC contract language for $2k cap; Karen -> confirm final eval sample set by tomorrow. React :thumbsup: when done or reply with objections.
